/ ABOUT US

We're building India's most trusted industrial workforce platform.

Concurve connects factories, warehouses and logistics floors to a pool of verified, skilled industrial workers - booked from an app and on the floor the same day.

/ OUR MISSION

Our Mission

"To power every Indian factory floor with safe, on-demand industrial labour - and to create dignified, predictable earnings for workers across the country."

/ How Concurve Started

Our Story

Concurve was founded in 2024 by a team of operators who spent years inside India's largest manufacturing and logistics floors - and saw firsthand how hard it is to find reliable, trained industrial workers when production demand suddenly spikes.

We built a platform that does the heavy lifting - background verification, skills assessment, onboarding and shift scheduling - so plant managers can focus on output, and workers can focus on showing up to a job that respects them.

Today, Concurve operates across industrial clusters in India, deploying pre-verified loaders, packers, machine operators, forklift drivers and helpers every single day.

/ WHAT WE STAND FOR

Our Values

Safety First

Every worker is background verified, ID-checked and trained before their first shift.

Respect & Dignity

Fair pay, safe conditions and treating every worker like a skilled professional.

Speed & Reliability

Book in the morning and workers can be on the line by the next shift.

Transparency

Clear pricing, live attendance and no hidden charges - ever.
